title: Performance evaluation of listed Vietnamese logistics companies in the pre-, during, and post- COVID-19 based on a three-layer MCDM method
core_idea: Apply a three-layer multi-criteria decision-making (MCDM) method to assess and compare the performance of listed Vietnamese logistics companies across pre-, during-, and post-COVID-19 periods.
tldr: Uses a three-layer MCDM approach to evaluate and compare the performance of listed Vietnamese logistics firms before, during, and after the COVID-19 pandemic.
